description: One data row of central/units.csv, read as an object of column name to cell text; an empty cell is null. The header row must be exactly the columns of x-columns, in that order. Generated from meterline_gold/write.py and meterline_gold/dataset_docs.py by meterline_gold.contract; do not edit by hand. Meaning of each column: docs/reference/gold-datasets.md and the gold spec, sections 6 to 8.

cost_center.description: Cost centre of the person or unit, from the organisation files.

dimension.description: Dimension of the unit tree the unit belongs to.

function.description: Function of the unit, from the organisation files.

head_key.description: person_key of the head of the unit.

key.description: Short key of the unit within its dimension.

kind.description: Kind of the unit, such as team or division.

parent_id.description: unit_id of the parent unit; empty for a root.

schema_version.description: GOLD_SCHEMA_VERSION of the build that wrote the file; the same on every row.

unit_id.description: Organisation unit id from the organisation files.

valid_from.description: First day the row is valid. A unit has one row per validity period: take the row valid on the day.

valid_to.description: Last day the row is valid; empty if open. A join on unit_id alone repeats people: check both ends of the range.

title: gold-dataset-units
x-grain: One row per organisation unit and validity period.
